sources.text:
FICTIONAL PUBLIC DEMO — all people, addresses and events below are invented.

I am Nila Aven. My spouse Teo Aven and I share the apartment at Sample Walk 6, apartment 1, Bern as our family home. On 5 October 2026 I personally received a registered item containing a tenancy-termination notice from our landlord. The letter proposed an end date of 31 March 2027. We dispute the termination and want the documents reviewed.

I attach our complete tenancy agreement and the original delivery record for the item addressed to me. I do not yet have a scan of the termination notice. Whether Teo received a separate notice is unknown; I have no such copy or delivery record.

We report no rent arrears or earlier tenancy-rights dispute. We have not decided about an extension and no hardship assessment has been completed. No challenge, settlement or outbound response has taken place. Please distinguish the recorded delivery from the unassessed legal validity and deadlines.

FICTIONAL PUBLIC DEMO DOCUMENT
All persons, addresses, signatures, amounts and events are invented. This is the complete original text of this synthetic document.

RESIDENTIAL TENANCY AGREEMENT — SW-2024-006
Signed on 18 September 2024.

Landlord: Sample Walk Homes SA, Fiction Square 5, 3000 Bern, Switzerland (fictional address).
Tenants: Nila Aven and Teo Aven, joint tenants and married spouses.
Property: Sample Walk 6, apartment 1, 3000 Bern, Switzerland (fictional address); a three-room residential apartment with cellar C1.
Occupancy: Nila Aven and Teo Aven reside together in this apartment as their family home.

The tenancy starts on 1 October 2024 and continues for an indefinite term. The premises are for the tenants' ordinary residential use. The agreed net monthly rent is CHF 1,940 and the monthly advance for ancillary costs is CHF 195. Payment is due on the first day of each month. The agreed deposit is CHF 3,880.

The contractual notice period is three months to 31 March, 30 June, 30 September or 31 December. A notice must identify the tenancy and intended termination date. These are the parties' recorded contractual terms; this agreement does not establish the validity or service of any later notice.

There are no omitted schedules or later amendments in this fictional agreement.
Landlord signature: Elin Vale, authorized representative of Sample Walk Homes SA (fictional signature).
Tenant signatures: Nila Aven and Teo Aven (fictional signatures).

FICTIONAL PUBLIC DEMO DOCUMENT
All persons, addresses, signatures and events are invented. This is the complete original delivery record in this synthetic case.

EXAMPLE PARCEL SERVICE — SIGNED DELIVERY RECORD
Record: EPS-DEMO-20261005-319
Service: registered letter with recipient signature.
Sender: Sample Walk Homes SA, Fiction Square 5, 3000 Bern (fictional address).
Named addressee: Nila Aven.
Delivery address: Sample Walk 6, apartment 1, 3000 Bern (fictional address).

The item was handed directly to Nila Aven at the delivery address on 5 October 2026 at 14:32 local time. Recipient identity was checked against the addressee name on the registered item. Nila Aven signed the delivery device upon receipt.
Recipient signature record: Nila Aven — received in person at 14:32 on 5 October 2026 (fictional signature).
Delivery agent: Neri Falk; route DEMO-BE-07 (fictional operator).
Service status: delivered; no failed delivery or proxy recipient is recorded.

Sender-declared item description: tenancy termination, reference SW-2024-006. The carrier did not open or authenticate the envelope contents. This record establishes only the named recipient, delivery method and recorded delivery date. It contains no delivery entry for Teo Aven and makes no statement about a separate item.
Record issued by Example Parcel Service on 5 October 2026 at 14:34 local time.
